svg.title: The language ladder: four nested classes of patterns, one example pattern on each rung (schematic)

g.text: Rung 0: any tape machine, unbounded tape
Blank-tape HALT: codes of machines that stop on a blank tape
Rung 1: context-sensitive, a tape as long as the input
ww: one word written twice, such as abbaabba
a^n b^n: n letters a, then n letters b, such as aaabbb
a*b*: every a before every b, such as aabbb
each boundary is a proved strict inclusion
